violations.text:
Cold holding equipment not maintained in good repair. Do not store time/temperature control for safety food in this unit until the unit is repaired.
Walk in cooler reading ambient 41-48f

Food stored on floor.
Boxes in walk in freezer

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Grease build up on hood filters and oven
Stop Sale issued on time/temperature control for safety food due to temperature abuse.

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
In walk in cooler overnight
rice (46F - Cold Holding); aioli (46F - Cold Holding); beef (48F - Cold Holding); loaded potatoes (46F - Cold Holding) Spinach dip 46f Prime rib 49f Mango tomato salsa 45f. Cooked Beef 46f. Prime rib 47f. Loaded potatoes 46f. Cooked crab meat 45f. Cooked beets 47f. Cooked noodles 50f. Blue cheese spread 51f. Butter 51f. All cold holding in cooler overnight

Time/temperature control for safety food, other than whole meat roast, hot held at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
spinach dip (79F - Hot Holding); for 30 min. Chef reheated. Now reading 166f

Cloth used as a food-contact surface.
Employee cutting lettuce on linens.manager spoke to employee

Dishmachine not washing/rinsing properly. Must wash, rinse and sanitize all dishware, equipment and utensils in three-compartment sink until dishmachine is functioning properly.
Bar #2 is not sanitizing. Glass machine is not in use

Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items.
Employee cell phone on prep table. Phone was removed

Hot time/temperature control for safety food received at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter 103-111f. Hot holding for 1 hour. Chef reheated 184f

Raw animal food stored over or with unwashed produce.
Raw burgers over mushrooms in glass cooler.
Raw shelled eggs over margarine in walk in

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
ham (44-46F - Cold Holding) in cooler for 45 minutes. Item moved to walk in to rapid chill

Proof of required state approved employee training not available for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.
